vb_textbox.text: It was hard for me to find a pattern, I found that Red and Brown went together and Green and Purple went together. If the amount of mushroom received on red was 5 or over I would continue to click red or brown. If the amount of mushrooms was less than 5 I would then switch to Green/purple and then stick with that combination while the mushrooms given were 5 or above. Good luck!
